title: Taking the Stand
description:
S01 E04 — Shayna Hubers
Shayna Hubers takes the stand to defend herself after murdering her on-again, off-again boyfriend, Ryan Poston; she willingly takes the stand to prove her actions were in self-defense, by showing Ryan's abusive side.

title: Taking the Stand
description:
S01 E05 — Eric Campbell
A 23-year-old Texas man facing the death penalty after being charged with killing an elderly West Virginia couple, decides to take the stand and points the finger at a surprising suspect he claims committed the crimes.

title: Taking the Stand
description:
S01 E06 — Leon Jacob
Former Houston doctor Leon Jacob takes the stand to defend his past after being found guilty of plotting, along with girlfriend Valerie McDaniel, the murder of his ex-girlfriend and Valerie's ex-husband.

title: Taking the Stand
description:
S01 E07 — Sean Foley
Sean Foley stands accused in the death of his girlfriend's stepfather, Jimmy Shelton, fatally shooting him after a booze-filled evening; Sean claims that Jimmy was the aggressor and was trying to sexually assault his girlfriend.

title: Taking the Stand
description:
S01 E08 — Sabrina Limon
When railroad mechanic Robert Limon is shot and killed by Jonathan Hearn, an investigation leads to Robert's widow and spurs questions about her involvement in the crime; Sabrina Limon takes the stand to contest Jonathan Hearn, her former lover.

title: Taking the Stand
description:
S01 E09 — Luke VanHemert
Luke VanHemert takes the stand to defend himself on a second-degree murder charge after a university student and athlete is stabbed to death following a minor traffic incident.

title: Court Cam Presents Under Oath
description:
S01 E01 — George Burch
George Burch stands accused of the brutal murder of Nicole VanderHeyden, a 31-year-old mother of three; George willingly takes the stand to prove he is not guilty and to provide the jury with an alternative suspect.

title: Taking the Stand
description:
S01 E01 — Jodi Arias
When a young Arizona businessman is found slaughtered in his bathroom, friends point police towards his ex-girlfriend; facing the death penalty, Jodi Arias takes the stand for 18 days in an attempt to explain how the killing was self-defense.

title: Taking the Stand
description:
S01 E02 — Amber Guyger
When an off-duty Dallas police officer shoots a man in his own apartment, the jury decides if it was murder or a tragic mistake; Amber Guyger takes the stand in her own defense to convince the jury not to lock her away for up to 99 years.

title: Taking the Stand
description:
S01 E03 — Scott Nelson
When a parolee is bounced from his job, he seeks retribution on a peaceful community when he kidnaps, tortures and kills a mother and caregiver; Scott Nelson takes the stand to give a convoluted explanation on why he blames his parole officer.

title: Interrogation Raw
description:
S02 E01 — The Missing Priest
The search for a missing priest leads detectives on a multi-state manhunt for a suspect who may be the only person with the answers to his whereabouts.

title: Interrogation Raw
description:
S02 E02 — A Christmas Nightmare
When a 25-year-old college student vanishes on Christmas Eve, investigators must piece together the details of a first date gone tragically wrong.

title: Interrogation Raw
description:
S02 E03 — Until Murder Do Us Part
When a 70-year-old grandmother passes away suspiciously on a road trip, investigators uncover a sinister murder plot while searching for her remains.

title: Interrogation Raw
description:
S02 E04 — The Killer Hitchhiker
After a man and a woman are found shot on the side of the highway, investigators struggle to find clues to catch the killer until a deputy locates the victim's missing car filled with guns, silencers, and a mysterious man behind the wheel.

title: Interrogation Raw
description:
S02 E05 — A Lover's Betrayal
After the dismembered remains of a missing woman are found in a freezer, investigators uncover a love triangle and a murderous conspiracy to conceal the truth.

title: Interrogation Raw
description:
S02 E06 — Shot in the Dark
A series of random nighttime shootings has the city of Phoenix on edge as police try to end the reign of terror and interrogate two suspects.

title: Interrogation Raw
description:
S02 E07 — Murdered Amongst Friends
After 22 years, a local news story reignites a decades-old cold case, leading investigators to question a close-knit circle of friends who they believe are hiding the truth about the disappearance of a 25-year-old man.

title: America's War on Drugs
description:
S01 E04 — Heroin, Terrorists & Kings of Pain
The intertwining of the War on Drugs and the War on Terror transforms Afghanistan into a narco-state; American intervention helps give rise to El Chapo and the super cartels; the pharmaceutical industry becomes a supplier of addictive substances.

title: America's War on Drugs
description:
S01 E03 — Gangs, Prisons & Meth Queens
The Clinton administration's support of NAFTA inadvertently opens the door to Mexican cartels; a crackdown on violence leads to mass incarceration; a celebrity's sister becomes a meth lord; powerful cartels begin a war for dominance.

title: America's War on Drugs
description:
S01 E02 — Cocaine, Cartels & Crack Downs
Cocaine gives rise to cartels; CIA shadow wars contribute to the first narco-state; crack floods into the United States as an unintended consequence of the fight against communism; a former DEA agent discusses U.S. culpability in the cocaine trade.

title: Mobsters
description:
S04 E06 — Carmine \"The Snake\" Persico
Carmine Persico stands as one of the most enduring Godfathers in mafia history.

title: Undercover: Caught on Tape
description:
S01 E99
Undercover police risk identity loss. This special shares their real stories.

title: Undercover: Caught on Tape
description:
S01 E04 — Too Close to Home
ATF Special Agents Dobyns and Kilday put their best feet forward only to have their lives put on the line.

title: Undercover: Caught on Tape
description:
S01 E05 — The Edge of Cover
An undercover NYPD officer and an ATF special agent learn not to trust a suspect's demeanor; forced to rely on their cover teams for support, Shaulene Wright and Scott Perala navigate the challenging terrain of deception in the undercover world.

title: Undercover: Caught on Tape
description:
S01 E07 — The Cost of Happiness
One FBI undercover agent meets with suspects in Denmark in an effort to retrieve one of the world's lost treasures, while another agent takes on an unlikely suspect believed to be planning a murder for hire.

title: Undercover: Caught on Tape
description:
S01 E06 — Small Towns, Big Crimes
Undercover agents Lyle Kirian and Brian Townsend embed themselves in two different, but equally dangerous worlds in order to investigate suspected local gang members and the Mexican cartel.

title: Undercover: Caught on Tape
description:
S01 E10 — Money Murder and Malicious Intent
On his last day as an undercover agent, Bergen County Detective Carlos James experiences his first shootout; ATF agent Jenn Eskew poses as a hit woman to investigate a possible murder for hire.

title: Undercover: Caught on Tape
description:
S01 E01 — High Stakes
Undercover ATF and DEA Agents are reminded to never judge a book by its cover and to always be on their toes; even small-time suspects have the potential to unleash terror, and no place seems safe or off-limits.
